# Sigstore interoperability fixture

`cosign-v3-blob.txt` and `cosign-v3-blob.sigstore.json` are the Apache-2.0
Cosign v3 interoperability fixture from `sigstore-verify` 0.8.0. They exercise
the same public-good trust-root, identity, issuer, timestamp, and transparency
verification used for signed packs. The fixture contains no private key.
